---
title: "Add or change a dog's photo"
subtitle: "SOP GRM-09 · Groomer manual"
---

## Purpose

Put a photo of the dog on its profile, so staff can tell dogs apart at a
glance in the list, on the card and on bookings.

## Applies to

Every groomer.

## Before you begin

- You are signed in to your profile.
- The dog's card is open. See [GRM-02 Check in a
  dog](checking-in-a-dog.qmd), steps 2 to 4.

## Procedure

1. Click **Add photo** under the picture at the top left of the dog's card.
   If the dog already has a photo, the button says **Change photo**.

   ![The photo buttons](/screenshots/groomer/dog-photo.png)

2. Click one:
   - **Take a photo:** on a tablet, the tablet's camera opens. On a computer,
     the webcam opens: click **Take the picture**, then **Use this photo**.
   - **Choose a photo:** choose a picture file saved on the tablet or
     computer.

   The photo is saved and appears on the dog's card.

### Remove a photo

1. Click **Change photo**.
2. Click **Remove photo**.
3. When asked **Take** the dog's **photo off their profile?**, click **OK**.

To close the photo buttons without changing anything, click **Cancel**.

## Result

The dog's photo appears on its card, in the dog list, and on the booking
form. Click the photo on the card to see it full size.

::: {.callout-note}
## Not in the online demo
The online demo of the app does not keep photos, so these buttons only
appear in the shop's own app.
:::
